suggestions: pre-filter a large table as a CTE before the join
reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
optimized_sql:
SELECT i.i_item_id,
       SUM(s.sum_qty)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(s.cnt_qty), 0) AS agg1,
       SUM(s.sum_list_price) / NULLIF(SUM(s.cnt_list_price), 0) AS agg2,
       SUM(s.sum_coupon_amt) / NULLIF(SUM(s.cnt_coupon_amt), 0) AS agg3,
       SUM(s.sum_sales_price) / NULLIF(SUM(s.cnt_sales_price), 0) AS agg4
FROM (
    SELECT ss_item_sk,
           COUNT(ss_quantity) AS cnt_qty,
           SUM(ss_quantity) AS sum_qty,
           COUNT(ss_list_price) AS cnt_list_price,
           SUM(ss_list_price) AS sum_list_price,
           COUNT(ss_coupon_amt) AS cnt_coupon_amt,
           SUM(ss_coupon_amt) AS sum_coupon_amt,
           COUNT(ss_sales_price) AS cnt_sales_price,
           SUM(ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales_price
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN (
        SELECT cd_demo_sk
        FROM customer_demographics
        WHERE cd_gender = 'F'
          AND cd_marital_status = 'W'
          AND cd_education_status = 'College'
    ) AS cd ON store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN (
        SELECT d_date_sk
        FROM date_dim
        WHERE d_year = 2001
    ) AS d ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN (
        SELECT p_promo_sk
        FROM promotion
        WHERE p_channel_email = 'N' OR p_channel_event = 'N'
    ) AS p ON store_sales.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    GROUP BY ss_item_sk
) AS s
JOIN item AS i ON s.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id
ORDER BY i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
